verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is an AI assistant and agent platform, so reaching paired devices is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions pairing phones or computers, or using remote devices for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback. Custom agent skills, MCP compatibility and the developer API are building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
